GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 420 (13 Nov 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 275)
APO 500
13 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Shipment of Winter Clothing and Equipment to the Philippines for Use by Repatriates returning to Japan in Shipping Provided by the Allied Powers.
1. In addition to the winter clothing and equipment being provided for use by Japanese repatriates returning from the Philippines in Japanese shipping as required by memorandum this Headquarters file AG 370.05 (15 Oct 45) GC, subject; "Reception Centers in Japan for Processing Repatriates," dated 15 October 1945, it is desired that winter clothing and equipment be provided for repatriates being returned from the Philippines to Japan in shipping provided by the Allied Powers.
2. It is therefore directed that you arrange to ship to Manila for the Commanding General, United States Army Forces, Western Pacific sufficient winter clothing and equipment to provide for 25,000 repatriates on the return trip to Japan in Allied shipping. This clothing and equipment is to be moved in Japanese shipping scheduled to sail to the Philippines and is to arrive at Manila by 1 December 1945 or as soon thereafter as practicable.
3. When the above equipment has been assembled and is ready for shipment this Headquarters will be informed of the name of the ship and estimated time of arrival at Manila.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
